python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
p='/app/benchmark_results.parquet'
df=pd.read_parquet(p)
print('All model means:')
print(df.groupby('model')['roc_auc'].agg(['mean','count','sum']).sort_values('mean', ascending=False).to_string())
print('\nXGBoost fold 0 rows:')
print(df[(df.model=='XGBoost') & (df.fold==0)].to_string(index=False))
print('\nExcluding XGBoost fold 0 model means:')
df2=df[~((df.model=='XGBoost') & (df.fold==0))]
print(df2.groupby('model')['roc_auc'].agg(['mean','count','sum']).sort_values('mean', ascending=False).to_string())
print('\nPer-model mean by dataset (excluding XGBoost fold 0):')
print(df2.pivot_table(index='model', columns='dataset', values='roc_auc', aggfunc='mean').round(4).to_string())

python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

path = '/app/benchmark_results.parquet'
df = pd.read_parquet(path)
metadata = pq.ParquetFile(path).metadata.metadata or {}
note = metadata.get(b'NOTE', b'').decode(errors='replace')
print('Parquet NOTE:', note)

if 'exclude fold 0 for XGBoost' in note:
    df = df[~((df['model'] == 'XGBoost') & (df['fold'] == 0))]

means = df.groupby('model')['roc_auc'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(means.to_string())
best_model = means.index[0]
with open('/app/result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(best_model)
print('Best model:', best_model)
